data.long_meaning: Sahnawaz is a Hindu name that means protector. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sahna', which means to protect or defend. This name is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and brave individuals, capable of safeguarding themselves and their loved ones. The name Sahnawaz carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Sahnawaz usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sahnawaz is a name that signifies the spiritual qualities of protection and defense. It represents the innate strength and courage that lies within each individual, and the desire to use this strength to shield and protect those around them.
data.etymology: Sahnawaz belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahnawaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
